Un hawaaon ki qasam jo baadalon ko muntashir karne waali hain
Phir baadal ka bojh uthaane waali hain
Phir dheere dheere chalne waali hain
Phir ek amr ki taqseem karne waali hain
Tum se jis baat ka waada kiya gaya hai woh sachchi hai
Aur jaza o saza bahar-haal waaqe hone waali hai
Aur mukhtalif raaston waale aasmaan ki qasam
Ke tum log mukhtalif baaton mein pade hue ho
Haq se wahi gumraah kiya ja sakta hai jo behkaaya ja chuka hai
Beshak atkal-pachchu lagaane waale maare jaayenge
Jo apni ghaflat mein bhoole pade hue hain
Yeh poochhte hain ke aakhir qiyaamat ka din kab aaega
To yeh wahi din hai jis din inhein Jahannam ki aag par tapaaya jaaega
Ke ab apna azaab chakho, aur yahi woh azaab hai jis ki tum jaldi machaaye hue the
Beshak muttaqi afraad baaghaat aur chashmon ke darmiyaan honge
Jo kuch un ka Parwardigar ata karne waala hai use wusool kar rahe honge, ke yeh log pehle se nek kirdaar the
Yeh raat ke waqt bahut kam sote the
Aur sehar ke waqt Allah ki baargaah mein istighfaar kiya karte the
Aur un ke amwaal mein maangne waale aur na maangne waale mahroom afraad ke liye ek haq tha
Aur zameen mein yaqeen karne waalon ke liye bahut si nishaaniyaan paayi jaati hain
Aur khud tumhaare andar bhi. Kya tum nahin dekh rahe ho
Aur aasmaan mein tumhaara rizq hai, aur jin baaton ka tum se waada kiya gaya hai sab kuch maujood hai
Aasmaan o zameen ke maalik ki qasam! Yeh Quran bilkul barhaq hai jis tarah tum khud baatein kar rahe ho
Kya tumhaare paas Ibraheem alaihis-salaam ke mohtaram mehmaanon ka zikr pahuncha hai
Jab woh un ke paas waarid hue aur salaam kiya to Ibraheem alaihis-salaam ne jawaab-e-salaam dete hue kaha ke tum to anjaani qaum maaloom hote ho
Phir apne ghar ja kar ek mota taaza bachhda tayyaar kar ke le aaye
Phir un ki taraf badha diya aur kaha: kya aap log nahin khaate hain
Phir apne nafs mein khauf ka ehsaas kiya to un logon ne kaha ke aap darein nahin, aur phir unhein ek daanishmand farzand ki bashaarat de di
Yeh sun kar un ki zauja shor machaati hui aayin aur unhon ne munh peet liya ke main budhiya baanjh (yeh kya baat hai)
Un logon ne kaha yeh aisa hi hoga, yeh tumhaare Parwardigar ka irshaad hai, woh badi hikmat waala aur har cheez ka jaanne waala hai
Ibraheem alaihis-salaam ne kaha ke aye farishto! Tumhein kya muhim darpesh hai
Unhon ne kaha ke humein ek mujrim qaum ki taraf bheja gaya hai
Taake un ke oopar mitti ke kharanje-daar patthar barsaayein
Jin par Parwardigar ki taraf se hadd se guzar jaane waalon ke liye nishaani lagi hui hai
Phir hum ne us basti ke tamaam momineen ko baahar nikaal liya
Aur wahaan musalmaanon ke ek ghar ke ilaawa kisi ko paaya bhi nahin
Aur wahaan un logon ke liye ek nishaani bhi chhod di jo dardnaak azaab se darne waale hain
Aur Moosa alaihis-salaam ke waaqe mein bhi hamaari nishaaniyaan hain jab hum ne un ko Fir'aun ki taraf khuli hui daleel de kar bheja
To us ne lashkar ke dam par munh mod liya aur kaha ke yeh jaadoogar ya deewaana hai
To hum ne use aur us ki fauj ko giraft mein le kar darya mein daal diya, aur woh qaabil-e-malaamat tha hi
Aur qaum-e-Aad mein bhi ek nishaani hai jab hum ne un ki taraf baanjh hawa ko chala diya
Ke jis cheez ke paas se guzar jaati thi use boseeda haddi ki tarah reza reza kar deti thi
Aur qaum-e-Samood mein bhi ek nishaani hai jab un se kaha gaya ke thode dinon maze kar lo
To un logon ne hukm-e-Khuda ki naafarmaani ki to inhein bijli ne apni giraft mein le liya aur woh dekhte hi reh gaye
Phir na woh uthne ke qaabil the aur na madad talab karne ke laaiq the
Aur un se pehle qaum-e-Nooh thi ke woh to sab hi faasiq aur badkaar the
Aur aasmaan ko hum ne apni taaqat se banaaya hai aur hum hi use wus'at dene waale hain
Aur zameen ko hum ne farsh kiya hai to hum behtareen hamwaar karne waale hain
Aur har shai mein se hum ne joda banaaya hai ke shaayad tum naseehat haasil kar sako
Lihaaza ab Khuda ki taraf daud pado ke main khula hua daraane waala hoon
Aur khabardaar us ke saath kisi doosre ko khuda na banaana ke main tumhaare liye waazeh taur par daraane waala hoon
Isi tarah un se pehle kisi qaum ke paas koi rasool nahin aaya magar yeh ke un logon ne yeh keh diya ke yeh jaadoogar hai ya deewaana
Kya unhon ne ek doosre ko isi baat ki wasiyyat ki hai? Nahin, balke yeh sab ke sab sarkash hain
Lihaaza aap un se munh mod lein, phir aap par koi ilzaam nahin hai
Aur yaad-dahaani bahar-haal karaate rahein ke yaad-dahaani saahibaan-e-imaan ke haq mein mufeed hoti hai
Aur main ne jinnaat aur insaanon ko sirf apni ibaadat ke liye paida kiya hai
Main un se na rizq ka talabgaar hoon aur na yeh chaahta hoon ke yeh mujhe kuch khilaayein
Beshak rizq dene waala, saahib-e-quwwat aur zabardast sirf Allah hai
Phir in zaalimeen ke liye bhi waise hi nataaij hain jaise un ke ashaab ke liye the, lihaaza yeh jaldi na karein
Phir kuffaar ke liye us din wail aur azaab hai jis din ka un se waada kiya ja raha hai
